episodes.title: A Kenyan Prophet Gathering Believers in The Forest Arrested & Prosecuted | Paul MacKenzie
episodes.description:
In this investigative and documentary-style episode on Reubby TV Official, we examine the controversial ministry of Paul Nthenge Mackenzie, the leader of Good News International Church, and the events surrounding the Shakahola tragedy that shocked Kenya and attracted international attention.

On October 19, 2026, a Kenyan High Court convicted Mackenzie and 28 co-accused in connection with 191 murder counts involving 190 children and one adult. The court found that an organised system of enforced fasting led to the deaths. Sentencing is scheduled for November 6, 2026.

This episode is not about attacking Christianity or genuine Christian believers. It is about examining specific teachings, documented events, judicial findings, and the consequences of extreme religious practices. No preacher should be beyond scrutiny, and every religious claim should be examined in the light of Scripture, evidence, and the duty to protect human life.

WATCH TO THE END and join the discussion: Where should the line be drawn between religious freedom and teachings that endanger human life? How can Christians distinguish sound biblical teaching from doctrines that cause harm?
